title: Acme Semiconductor (ACMS) beats Q3 estimates on data-center demand
text:
Acme Semiconductor reported third-quarter revenue of $4.2 billion, ahead of analyst estimates of $3.9 billion, driven by demand for its data-center accelerators.

The company raised its full-year guidance and said supply constraints on advanced packaging would ease in the first half of next year.

Shares of ACMS rose 6% in after-hours trading. Chief executive Dana Ruiz said orders from cloud providers had doubled year over year, and that the company expects its next-generation chip to ship in volume by mid-2027.

Analysts at Example Research noted that gross margin expanded to 61%, the highest in the company's history, and kept their buy rating on the stock.
